# Port Nereid (LV-109 'Elgin's Folly')
## Under Construction This page is still being written. Until then, here is the location's lore primer.
[italic]Date 2181 - Port Nereid, a valuable waterport, atmospheric processor and transit hub on the Neroid Sector frontier world LV-109, named 'Elgin's Folley'. Port Nereid is a joint-venture colony established by the United Americas Colonial Administration and Weyland-Yutani.[/italic]
